arequipa: Arequipa, Peru: the Plaza de Armas seen from under the white volcanic sillar stone arcades, with the cathedral facade and the snow-capped El Misti volcano rising behind it in the distance.
ayacucho: Ayacucho, Peru: a quiet colonial street of whitewashed houses with wooden balconies leading to a stone church with twin bell towers, Andean hills behind.
chiclayo: Chiclayo region, Peru: the long wooden pier of Pimentel beach stretching into the Pacific in late afternoon light, a few traditional reed fishing boats resting on the sand.
cajamarca: Cajamarca, Peru: the colonial plaza with its carved stone baroque church facade and a green Andean valley with patchwork fields on the hills behind.
cusco: Cusco, Peru: the Plaza de Armas with the cathedral and the Compania de Jesus church seen from a hillside balcony of terracotta roofs, the green Andean mountains behind.
iquitos: Iquitos, Peru: the riverside boardwalk of the Amazon city overlooking the wide brown Itaya river and dense rainforest on the far shore, wooden boats moored below.
jauja: Jauja, Peru: the calm Paca lagoon in the Mantaro valley with totora reeds at the shore, small rowing boats and soft Andean hills around it.
juliaca: Lake Titicaca near Juliaca, Peru: the floating Uros reed islands with traditional totora reed boats on the calm blue lake and the high Andean plateau on the horizon.
pucallpa: Pucallpa, Peru: the Yarinacocha lagoon in the Amazon with long wooden peque-peque boats tied at a rustic dock and lush green jungle along the water.
trujillo: Huanchaco beach near Trujillo, Peru: traditional caballitos de totora reed boats standing upright on the sand by the Pacific shore and the old wooden pier.
talara: Lobitos beach near Talara, Peru: a desert coastline with long Pacific waves, an old wooden pier and a few weathered beach houses on the bluff.
puerto-maldonado: Puerto Maldonado, Peru: the Tambopata river winding through the Amazon rainforest, a wooden canoe at the muddy riverbank and tall jungle trees.
tumbes: Tumbes, Peru: the warm Zorritos beach on the northern Peruvian coast with calm sea, a few fishing boats and dry coastal hills.
tacna: Tacna, Peru: the Paseo Civico with the stone Parabolic Arch monument and the Bolognesi cathedral, palm trees and a clear desert sky.
tarapoto: Tarapoto, Peru: green rolling jungle hills of the San Martin region with a waterfall falling into a natural pool among tropical vegetation.
piura: Mancora beach in Piura, Peru: a sunny Pacific beach with fishing boats on the sand, palm-roof beach huts and gentle waves.
sao-paulo: Sao Paulo, Brazil: Avenida Paulista seen from a sidewalk with its modern towers and street trees, the city skyline extending into soft haze.
miami: Miami Beach, USA: Ocean Drive with pastel Art Deco hotels and tall palm trees beside the beach promenade.
rio-de-janeiro: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil: Sugarloaf Mountain seen from the Urca waterfront wall with small boats in the calm Guanabara bay.
santiago: Santiago, Chile: the city skyline with the Gran Torre Costanera and the snow-capped Andes behind, seen from a green hillside park viewpoint.
punta-cana: Punta Cana, Dominican Republic: a palm-fringed Caribbean beach with white sand and calm clear water, a wooden beach lounger in the shade.
